item.text: I’ll read `input.json`, enumerate all feasible subsets, and verify the selected portfolio and count independently.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json,itertools
with open(\"input.json\") as f: d=json.load(f)
actions=sorted(d[\"actions\"],key=lambda a:a[\"id\"])
scenarios=sorted(d[\"scenarios\"],key=lambda s:s[\"id\"])
feasible=[]
for n in range(len(actions)+1):
 for chosen in itertools.combinations(actions,n):
  ids=tuple(a[\"id\"] for a in chosen)
  selected=set(ids)
  cost=sum(a[\"cost\"] for a in chosen)
  if cost>d[\"budget\"]: continue
  if any(not set(a[\"requires\"]) <= selected for a in chosen): continue
  if any(set(pair) <= selected for pair in d[\"incompatible\"]): continue
  losses={s[\"id\"]: max(0,s[\"base_loss\"]-sum(s[\"reductions\"].get(i,0) for i in ids)-sum(b[\"reduction\"] for b in s[\"bonuses\"] if set(b[\"actions\"]) <= selected)) for s in scenarios}
  worst=max(losses.values())
  weighted=sum(losses[s[\"id\"]]*s[\"weight\"] for s in scenarios)
  feasible.append(((worst,weighted,cost,ids),losses))
feasible.sort()
key,losses=feasible[0]
print(json.dumps({\"actions\":key[3],\"cost\":key[2],\"scenario_losses\":losses,\"worst_loss\":key[0],\"weighted_loss\":key[1],\"feasible_portfolios\":len(feasible)}))
print(json.dumps({\"top_five\":[{\"objective\":key,\"losses\":losses} for key,losses in feasible[:5]],\"feasible_by_cardinality\":{str(n):sum(len(k[3])==n for k,l in feasible) for n in range(len(actions)+1)}}))'"
